description: A small pixel-art figure has an oversized, square cream face framed in layered brown and tan blocks. Dark square eyes and pink cheeks give it a gentle, endearing expression. A brown stem rises from its head, branching into two broad lime-green leaves. Its compact pale body features a green geometric chest detail, tiny arms, and short blocky legs. The palette blends warm beige, earthy brown, muted olive, and bright yellow-green against black or charcoal backgrounds dotted with white star-like pixels. The overall mood is cozy, playful, botanical, and retro-digital.
